title: [Day 04] Incremental DOM mutations
text:
Part 2 verified.

What I checked:
- CI on 2d829d7 is green (lint, typecheck, test, build). Vercel preview is ready.
- Test-first: `test(recorder): order mutations and handle edge cases (#4)` (1032824) comes before `feat(recorder): order mutations and handle edge cases (#4)` (2d829d7). The test commit only adds tests (264 lines, no Part 1 test changed). The implementation commit does not touch any test file.
- Requirements, one test each: add then remove in one batch produces nothing, a moved node keeps its id (remove plus add with the same id), a nested add is serialized once, a repeated attribute keeps the last value (and a removed attribute is `null`). Extra tests cover masking and blocking, `on*` and script stripping, and the full order.
- The ordering is explained in the bot note on this PR and in ADR 0023, which is listed in `docs/decisions/README.md`. `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` is updated.
- Commits are authored as the owner with the Cursor Agent co-author trailer.

Part 3 starts now.
